label: Self-giving is also efficient self-causation under the selected causal sense
term: bridge between time-indexed self-giving and efficient self-causation
definition: SelfGivingIsEfficientSelfCause F EfficientlyCausesIn means: for each world v, candidate c and moment t, if F.GivesAt v c c t (c exercises concurrent giving of its own esse at t) then EfficientlyCausesIn c c F.esse. The target is a distinct supplied efficient-cause relation in a particular respect, not F.CausesIn (cause of a perfection) or a vague causal-power predicate. The bridge only constrains the potential self-case and is weaker than the full relation inclusion for all c,x. Index collapse: v ranges over every history of the frame (not only accessible ones) and t over moments, while EfficientlyCausesIn has neither index. The bridge is therefore meant with EfficientlyCausesIn read world- and time-neutrally (c is, in some history at some moment, an efficient cause of x's being r), not on the here-and-now gloss of definition 69c0b23e, under which self-giving in a merely possible history would become an actual present efficient self-cause. Arguments using it read the reused no-self-cause and cause-priority premises (8b2561cd, e078f07b) under the same modal reading, which is stronger than their actual-world gloss. Its independent applicability is a substantive OPEN causal interpretation.
note: The priority argument being imported is Aquinas's already verified Second Way no-self-cause derivation. Its priority sense is F.PriorSimply, not chronological order; the bridge is a conditional meaning link rather than a new source attribution. The source's 'nec est possibile' (q.2 a.3) is a candidate basis for the modal reading of no efficient self-causation; that attribution is deferred. Distinct from the existing efficient-esse bridge DistinctActualEsseCauseIsEfficient (definition 8934912c), which passes from CausesIn to the tenseless EfficientlyCausesEsse only for a cause distinct from its effect and so cannot cover the self-edge. The selfGivingFrame control retains both priority premises while falsifying this bridge and no-self-giving.
